title: Optimization-time-vs-dataset-size effect not tested on other datasets
description: The paper documents a sharp increase in optimization steps as dataset size decreases, but acknowledges this has only been studied on algorithmic binary operation tables and proposes investigating whether the effect holds for other (non-algorithmic) datasets.
canonical_description: whether the sharp increase in optimization steps with decreasing dataset size generalizes to non-algorithmic datasets

evidence.quote: it would be useful to investigate in future work whether the effect is also present for other datasets.
